# Spark Control Center 1.2.0

This release combines the planned template/batch-operations and proactive-alerting milestones into one production upgrade.

![Versioned SparkApplication templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApolloMeridian/spark-application-webui/v1.2.0/docs/images/templates-1440.png)

![Proactive alert center](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApolloMeridian/spark-application-webui/v1.2.0/docs/images/alerts-1440.png)

## Highlights

- PostgreSQL-backed, versioned SparkApplication templates with typed parameters, required/default values, enum and regex validation, copy/disable flows, and explicit rejection of embedded Secret data.
- Render templates into the existing Kubernetes server-side dry-run workflow before submission.
- Server-side application filtering, pagination, and sorting with shareable URL query state, per-user favorites, and a responsive high-density table.
- Permission-aware batch terminate/delete preview, mandatory confirmation, per-item backend authorization, and independent audit outcomes.
- Alert rules for failed applications, long Pending/SUBMITTED duration, resource pressure, and repeated failures/retries.
- Alert center with evidence, confidence, recommendations, acknowledgement, one-hour silence, recovery state, and lifecycle association.
- PostgreSQL failure-fingerprint aggregation across lifecycle snapshots and an optional generic JSON webhook for newly opened alerts.
- Idempotent schema migration from 1.1.0; existing users, sessions, audits, and application snapshots remain intact.

## Release assets

- `spark-control-center-1.2.0.tar` — frontend image (`spark-control-center:1.2.0`).
- `spark-control-center-backend-1.2.0.tar` — backend image (`spark-control-center-backend:1.2.0`).
- `spark-control-center-1.2.0.tgz` — Helm chart.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for the packaged artifacts.

The image names do not contain a private registry prefix.

## Upgrade notes

Upgrade PostgreSQL credentials and backup policy remain unchanged. The backend creates the new template, favorite, alert-rule, alert, and template-version tables automatically at startup. Configure `alerts.evaluationInterval`; set `alerts.webhook.enabled=true` and an absolute `alerts.webhook.url` only when outbound notifications are required.
